title: Monotonicity of the gate lists
statement: Let $F$ be a finite layered Boolean circuit whose gates use only identity, NOT, and unbounded fan-in AND operations. For any natural numbers $m\le M$, the list of gates through layer $M$ is the list of gates through layer $m$ followed by some list of additional gates.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a layered circuit over $\mathrm{Fin}\,2$ with $n$ inputs and output type $\mathrm{Unit}$
Every gate operation of $F$ is identity, NOT, or unbounded fan-in AND
$m$ and $M$ are natural numbers with $m\le M$
